events.note: NHLR and Forest Lookouts both date the 54-foot tower and cab to 1959

notes_for_editor: Build year 1959 and the 54-foot tower with CL-100 cab agree across NHLR and Forest Lookouts. Staffing and access rest on one Forest Service trail page (it carries a July 22, 2025 date line; what that date marks is not stated), which says the tower is used in peak fire season and visitors are welcome; no staff names or fire history found. The brief's access 'unknown' is superseded by the Forest Service statement. No rental listing found; the NHLR rentals page read did not name Juniper Ridge. A Facebook post about the lookout being staffed for the season turned up in search but could not be read, so it is not used. Record height_m 16.5 matches 54 ft. Record lat/lon match NHLR coordinates. No corrections proposed. Climbing status is not stated in any source read, so no climbable flag is recorded.
